rendered: The sodiation of the carbon layer provides 0.05 mAh/cm^2[1] per area (the document also gives this as about 120 mAh/g[2]). The highest plating capacity demonstrated is up to 12 mAh/cm^2[3]. The sodiation capacity is therefore a fraction of about 0.42%[4] of that maximum plating capacity, which the document itself calls negligible in comparison.

source.text: provided by the sodiation of the carbon layer, 0.05 mAh/cm^2
(or 120 mAh/g), is negligible in comparison to the plating
capacities, up to 12 mAh/cm^2, we demonstrate in this work.
